description: 15 ingredient lists in the style of popular Indian/international products, written by the developer for testing (not copied from current packs: real recipes vary by country and batch). 'expected' = what a consumer should see per category, written by the developer following reports/entity_schema.md - an author-made check, not the team's gold annotation.
